title: Observation
description: Evidence introduced into a discussion. The raw material from which questions and hypotheses are built.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A short descriptive title summarizing the observation.

discussion.description: ID of the Discussion this observation belongs to.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this observation was recorded.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor who recorded this observation.

sources.description: URLs, citations, or references that substantiate this observation.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
